title: 2020 Part Time AD
about: A short reflection on volunteering as an Assistant Director for three days during State Arts-In's unusual all-online 2020 season.
description: COVID completely changed State Arts-In in 2020, moving the program away from its normal stages and fairgrounds and onto computer screens. Instead of hiring the usual paid Assistant Directors, Kirsten invited alumni and former applicants to volunteer and help keep the program going. Because I was working at the time, I could only participate on my three days off. It was a small role in a very unusual year, but those three days still gave me a chance to return, help out, and be part of SAI when simply keeping the program moving required everyone to adapt.
lyrics: Kirsten asked alumni and former applicants to help.
You were working, so you could only be there three days.
Even three days felt worth it.
I was only a part-time AD,
Three little days were enough for me.
Still found a way to see it through.
Keeping State Arts In alive that way.
